releaseNotes: Security Audit & Clean Architecture: Purged experimental Game Booster and Radio background modules
Prevented kernel handle leaks in process monitoring routines (ProcessSecurityManager)
Implemented atomic safe file writing with disk flush to prevent configuration corruption
Hardened local secret persistence using Windows DPAPI encryption
Added network anti-SSRF protections and strictly enforced HTTPS-only endpoints
Sanitized file paths against traversal and NTFS Alternate Data Stream exploits
Secured PowerShell updater execution path to prevent search-order hijacking
